contract: One email through Swoosh's SMTP adapter and gen_smtp, bound to the core/effect declaration and the delivery/effect-intent owner: accepted{provider_id} is acceptance not delivery; refused{invalid_address | rejected_recipient | too_large | throttled | authentication_failed | credentials_unavailable | connect_failed}; unknown{reason} after handover or for an unclassifiable transaction reply; no Adapter retry; injected credential and trust Needs; verified TLS for every non-loopback relay.
limits: No inbox delivery, receipt, bounce, provider authenticity, exactly-once or provider-side deduplication claim; the stable Message-ID is a correlation hint only.
SMTP has no status query: an unknown outcome stays unknown until host/operator reconciliation through the EffectIntent owner.
ASCII addresses only (no SMTPUTF8), at most 50 recipients and 65,536 request bytes; STARTTLS only, no implicit TLS (port 465); one fixed relay, no MX lookup.
Stage classification relies on gen_smtp 1.3.0's session/transaction split; a transaction-stage failure is never refused unless its reply code is one of the listed ones.
Finite tests against an in-process loopback gen_smtp_server only; no proof is claimed.
The completion seal is process-local integrity of the Adapter's own transport result, not provider authentication; after a restart nothing can complete a recovered attempt through this boundary.

grounding.claim: Pinned Cure compilation type-checks the pure stage/reply-to-outcome decision used at runtime; not a proof of transport behaviour.

Named scenarios against an in-process loopback gen_smtp_server: accepted, invalid address, rejected recipient, too large, authentication failure, throttling, dropped connection after DATA, deadline, same identity twice, redaction in logs/errors/inspect/status/telemetry, credential Need shapes, connection refused, forged completion, classification table, configuration, verified TLS and the runtime:false smoke test; finite evidence, not proof.
Swoosh 1.29.3 email composition and SMTP adapter deliver/2 as read at the pinned version; its Mailer telemetry is deliberately not used.
gen_smtp 1.3.0 client session/transaction error split, retries option and STARTTLS handling, and its server used as the test server; SMTP reply semantics (RFC 5321) are named, not proved.
OTP 29.1.2 ssl peer and hostname verification and crypto HMAC-SHA-256.
Elixir 1.20.4 Logger process level and Task.Supervisor semantics.

A relay's 250 after DATA means it took responsibility for the message (acceptance, not delivery); the host keeps the credential and trust Needs truthful; a session-stage failure sent no envelope address or message byte (gen_smtp 1.3.0 source structure; tested scenarios only).

telemetry.contract: No events of its own and no Swoosh Mailer events (which would carry email and config). Own events through runtime/telemetry: future task when a consumer needs them. Not inherited: runtime/telemetry is not a dependency of this Piece.

config.contract: Build-time binding (relay, port, sender, id, recovery grace) entering the intent key; construction-time TLS mode and trust, size bound, send timeout, EHLO name, transport supervisor and credential Need; per-request deadline from the declaration; no hot update.

control.contract: No lifecycle of its own: dispatch, rearm, poll and expiry are the delivery/effect-intent owner's Control.
